desc: Implement the fixed-\(D\) threshold-layer min-cut construction with source label 0 and sink label \(D\) constraints.
Prove that finite cuts correspond exactly to valid labels satisfying \(d_v-d_u\le1\), and that unit cut cost equals the number of selected edges.
Establish that feasibility with at most \(K\) selected edges extends to exactly \(K\) edges without reducing the shortest distance.
Implement binary search over \(D\in[0,N-1]\), handling parallel edges, direct source-sink edges, and \(D=0\).
Validate the complete stdin/stdout Python program against all samples.
